tagline: Classic open-source custom Minecraft launcher for managing multiple isolated instances.
description: MultiMC is a custom open-source launcher for Minecraft focused on predictability, long-term stability, and simplicity. Easily manage multiple isolated game instances, mods, resource packs, and Java settings.
features: Isolated instances for separate versions and modpacks
Built-in mod, world, and resource pack management
Integrated Java version management and crash logs
